item.title: Beyond These Stars
item.description:
Title: Beyond These Stars
Genre: Simulation , Strategy
Developer: Balancing Monkey Games
Publisher: Hooded Horse
Release Date: Oct 16, 2026




About This Game

Recovering from uncertain times, your Peeps find themselves on the back of Kewa - a lonely Space Whale journeying across the universe. Building a city on the back of a sentient creature comes with its own set of challenges, but as you build your relationship and travel across the galaxy, you'll come across great opportunities for exploration and stable expansion. Meet other species, pursue the needs and wants of your Peeps, and seek the truth about their ancestors and the Space Whales alike.

The vastness of space is full of mysteries, and as you first arrive at your new home atop the Space Whale Kewa, your Peeps will quickly learn the need to work together – with each other, but also with their new home.

  • A Home Among the Stars - Build a sprawling city on the back of a universe-traveling Space Whale as your Peeps seek places to live and work. Your new home is largely desolate and inhospitable when you arrive, save for a small patch of green by the water – work around the contours of the land as you plan your city, taking into account the efficiency of your production chains. Will you simply place buildings as the land allows, or will you change its very shape to take advantage of adjacency bonuses and reduced travel times?

  • Reach Far and Wide - Terraform the land around you to better suit your needs. Create a thriving ecosystem by digging canals and adding top soil in preparation for farming. Plant trees to maintain a steady flow of raw materials, and maintain entire forests to help spread the atmosphere and facilitate the expansion of your city.

  • A Fragile Equilibrium - Prepare to seek out additional resources as you research new technologies and gain access to advanced goods. Your people’s needs will grow, and complex logistics networks and mining infrastructure will follow. You must be careful not to tip the delicate balance of the ecosystem, however – the land on Kewa is fragile, and if not tended to with care, your habitat will shrink. Will you walk a fine line of sustainability by risking Kewa’s ecosystem, or will you seek opportunities to instead gather resources on other worlds to keep Kewa happy?

Unveil the shared history of the galaxy as you travel from system to system with Kewa – seek answers about your past, learn about the history of the Space Whales, and understand the unique relationships that bind everyone together.

  • Reliable Outposts - Kewa’s environment is plentiful, but not without limits – there will often be a dearth of essential resources and space, and you’ll want to ensure the environment is not over-exploited. Create outposts on nearby planets and seek out supplementary sources of what you need – but unless you build a strong relationship with Kewa, you may find it difficult to predict how long you have at an outpost before Kewa decides it's time to leave a system behind.

  • A Travel Companion - Kewa longs for connection, and is no mere pet – your home has hopes and dreams for the journey through space. Through understanding Kewa’s needs and desires you can better build a symbiotic relationship. This will give you the opportunity to work in collaboration and allow you to decide on a path together as you journey across the universe.

  • Friends Along the Way - On your journey, you will cross paths with alien species offering unique opportunities – additional objectives and their subsequent rewards, opportunities for trade, and new technologies with the doors they open.

Balance your people’s survival, prosperity, and progress with the need to co-exist with Kewa in a journey across space. Beyond These Stars asks you to consider the logistics of your supply chains and production lines within the context of a living, breathing, sentient world.

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
    • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-6600 (quad-core) / AMD® Ryzen™ 3 3200G (quad-core)
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 960 (4 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ RX 570 (4 GB)
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 7 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
    • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-9600 (hexa-core) / AMD® Ryzen™ 5 2600X (hexa-core)
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 2070 (8 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ RX 6600 XT (8 GB)
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 7 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: SSD recommended

item.title: A Game About Needle In A Haystack
item.description:
Title: A Game About Needle In A Haystack
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Little Field Studios
Publisher: Little Field Studios
Release Date: Oct 16, 2026




About This Game

A Game About Needle In A Haystack is a single-player, first-person game. Somewhere inside a huge haystack there is one needle. Your job is to find it.



Dig
Pull hay from the pile by hand. Every strand you take goes into your bag.



Sell
Carry a full bag to the cow and sell the hay for money.

Upgrade



Spend money in the workshop on bigger bags, faster hands and new tools:
  • Pitchfork: takes a large clump of hay per swing
  • Dynamite: throw it into the pile to blast out a crater
  • Vacuum: sucks up hay continuously, but overheats

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Game logo was created with help of AI tools.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10 or above
    • Processor: Intel or AMD
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Direct X compatible
    • Storage: 2 GB available space

item.title: Flipping is Hard
item.description:
Title: Flipping is Hard
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie
Developer: Elegant Horse Studios
Publisher: Elegant Horse Studios , Dawn Wood Games
Release Date: Oct 16, 2026




About This Game

This game will test your patience , your phone skills , and your friendships . You can either:

  • Play Solo - Master the flip, struggle your way up, and experience the story alone.

  • Play Online CO-OP - Struggling together with up to 16 friends.

No Legs. Just Flips.

  • Rotate-Only Movement - Flippy doesn't have legs... Your only movements are rotation and a vibration jump.

  • Hard Climb - Small mistake, big drop. 10 different areas and a clear goal - reach the top and reunite with your boy.

Struggle Together

  • Help Each Other - Use Beams and Microwaves to help your friends.

  • Proximity Chat - Yell at your friends as everything goes wrong

Get back to Jeff

Little Jeff slipped on a strategically placed banana peel and accidentally yeeted Flippy into a storm drain... Now they're separated... Get your way back to Jeff for the happy ending they deserve!

Chill Mode (optional)

Want the story with less suffering? Play with checkpoints enabled and enjoy a more forgiving climb.

Speedrun Friendly

Quick restarts, built-in splits, and hard to master movement.

And More!

  • NPC Challenges – 16 different NPCs with challenges (side quests) that test your movement skills and reward only those who complete them.

  • Fashionista Flippy – Customize Flippy with different phone cases, charms, stickers and more! Even a phone always wants to look its best.

  • Do you Have Games on your Phone? – The answer is yes! Find, unlock, and play classic mobile games from the past. Truly a game-ception.

WARNING!

This difficult game tests your patience.

Falling is part of the challenge.

Will you RISE or QUIT when it gets tough?

    • DirectX: Version 10

    Recommended:

    • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770K / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060, AMD Radeon RX 470, or better
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 2 GB available space

item.title: Tenebris Somnia
item.description:
Title: Tenebris Somnia
Genre: Adventure , Indie
Developer: Andrés Borghi , Saibot Studios
Publisher: New Blood Interactive
Release Date: Oct 16, 2026




About This Game

Tenebris Somnia is a survival horror adventure game in the same vein as classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil - but adapted to a retro 2D aesthetic from the 8 or 16-bit era.

You will struggle to survive while solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures.

Yet the secrets of the game lie within its cinematics...

When you reach certain key points you will see sequences from a completely different point of view, made in live action with real actors and practical effects - created by a professional and award winning film crew from Argentina.

item.title: Penguin Colony
item.description:
Title: Penguin Colony
Genre: Action , Adventure , Casual , Indie
Developer: ORIGAME DIGITAL
Publisher: Fellow Traveller
Franchise: Shadows of Madness
Release Date: Oct 16, 2026




About This Game

"I am writing this under an appreciable mental strain..."

A faithful re-imagining of H.P. Lovecraft through the eyes of a penguin. Developed by Origame Digital, creators of Umurangi Generation, published by Fellow Traveller (1000xRESIST), and narrated by Lenval Brown.

“The wind howls differently in the S̴̭̘̥͉̘̤̺͚͈̫̘̎̉̀̊͛̿͗̃́́͐̊̐̓̊͠ͅouth”

The year is 1939, and the Nazis and Kaitiaki are making their way into the deep Antarctic to answer the call of an impossibly ancient being. One group seeks to extract this inconceivable power for its own destructive means. The other, as it has been doing for generations, hopes to return it to its slumber for another hundred years.

“Is it possible that what I have e̸̘̽x̷͔̿p̷̢̓e̴̗͠r̷̫̓ì̷͖ĕ̸͓n̷͇͘c̵̠͌e̸̜̓d̶̗̆ shall be believed?”

These humans, with their strange sights and sounds, will pique the curiosity of the local penguins. Embody any one of these penguins and wander the frozen landscape, following the humans in their discoveries, and witnessing their minds collapse under the strain.

“Or will my wö̴̭̥́̌̓̒̅rds come across like those of a m̴̜͉̻̙̮̳̺͕̼̤̥̯͙̞̉̔͆̀̉̈̃̑̔̀̉́́͘͜ͅa̴̢̛̩͚̣̼̘̱̥̰͉͗̈͌͆̕ͅͅd̷͇͝ ̵̧̗́͠m̵͚͓̎̐ạ̴̠̃n̶̹̾͝?̴̦̞̉́”

Part adaptation, part re-imagination, Penguin Colony is a sincere expansion of H.P. Lovecraft’s mythos. Drawing inspiration from stories like At the Mountains of Madness and The Shadow Out of Time, the game is set just two years after Lovecraft’s death, and carries on his tradition of weird fiction.

About the Developer

ORIGAME DIGITAL is a new media studio located in Ahitereiria. Developers of the IGF Grand Prize Winner Umurangi Generation (2020). Combining the new medium of Video Games with the Original story telling ways that's what ORI-GAME is all about. Next time you feel like something fresh check out an ORIGAME.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

This game includes depictions of blood, gore, scenes of sudden and violent deaths, and depictions of self-harm and suicide.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: i7
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GTX 1080
    • DirectX: Version 10
    • Storage: 2 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
